none: PAS NCL-1199D1: NCL-1199D1: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A military lead sealing dating to the Roman period. The sealing is oval in shape, on the underside, hexagonal on the upper surface. It is rectangular in section. Extending from the oval portion of the sealing on the underside are two hemispherical-section lugs, presumably marking the location of a horizontal piercing and chord. The upper surface of the sealing is decorated with a winged Victory…
